## Reading problem
What user task was interrupted? Why is this change smaller or clearer than adding another workflow?

## Changes
Describe behavior, evidence/provenance and data/permission effects.

## Validation
State exact commands, browsers/devices and results. Distinguish mocks from live integrations. Include synthetic before/after screenshots for visible changes.

## Limits
What was not tested? Does this require a new release or migration?

- [ ] No private papers, credentials, launch tokens or user records are included.
- [ ] Errors preserve the reader’s input and original source.
- [ ] Documentation describes shipped behavior, with unreleased changes clearly marked.
